sources.title: Merlin workflow specification
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Balsam：多任務裝箱、長尾與集合工期
related.titleEn: Balsam: ensemble packing, long tails and makespan
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每筆科學資料具完整血緣，新增樣本策略可被審查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Every scientific datum has complete lineage and an auditable adaptive-selection policy.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Balsam：多任務裝箱、長尾與集合工期」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付兩種四槽時間圖、總工作下界、任務身分與尾端診斷。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Balsam: ensemble packing, long tails and makespan using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver two four-slot timelines, a total-work lower bound, task identities and a tail diagnosis distinguishing scheduling effects from inaccurate workload estimates.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 為每樣本畫前處理到模擬到分析，列六十個邏輯鍵；另按階段各二十核對。
前四任務從零到四秒；兩長任務再從四到十二秒，標出後段空閒兩槽。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw preprocessing-to-simulation-to-analysis for every sample and enumerate sixty logical keys. Cross-check twenty entries per stage, ensuring stage names cannot collide or overwrite artifacts from another sample.

Run the four short tasks from zero to four seconds, then the two long tasks from four to twelve. Mark the two idle slots during the tail and explain why available capacity cannot accelerate nonpreemptive single-slot tasks automatically.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TAU：跨rank因果順序與時鐘修正界線
related.titleEn: TAU: cross-rank causality and clock-correction bounds
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：每筆科學資料具完整血緣，新增樣本策略可被審查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Every scientific datum has complete lineage and an auditable adaptive-selection policy.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「TAU：跨rank因果順序與時鐘修正界線」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付原始與修正時間、message配對、約束表及不可行反例；原始trace不覆寫，並明示未估計時鐘不確定性與網路延遲。
related.differenceEn: Investigate TAU: cross-rank causality and clock-correction bounds using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver raw and corrected timestamps, message matches, constraint tables and an infeasible counterexample. Preserve original traces and explicitly state that clock uncertainty and physical network latency have not been estimated.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 為每樣本畫前處理到模擬到分析，列六十個邏輯鍵；另按階段各二十核對。
將兩個前向條件寫成95+delta≥101與102+delta≥111，分別得到6與9；使用最大下界，而非平均兩個offset需求。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw preprocessing-to-simulation-to-analysis for every sample and enumerate sixty logical keys. Cross-check twenty entries per stage, ensuring stage names cannot collide or overwrite artifacts from another sample.

Write the forward constraints as 95 plus delta at least 101 and 102 plus delta at least 111. Derive bounds six and nine and explain why their maximum, rather than their average, satisfies both inequalities simultaneously.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
